description: This PHP source file contains functions related to retrieving and displaying tickets assigned to the current user in the HelpDesk module of vtiger CRM. It includes logic for querying the database for user-specific open tickets, formatting results for display, and linking to parent entities like Accounts and Contacts.

methods.name: getMyTickets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of open and assigned tickets for the current user, formatted for display with links and status indicators. Can also calculate the count of tickets if specified.

methods.name: getParentLink
methods.description: Returns an HTML link to the parent entity (Account or Contact) associated with a ticket, using a cache for efficiency.
